gaps.explanation: p8 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints Water and Sewer enterprise columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. JSON receipts = operating revenues + interest income. Water: Charges for services 351,138 + Connect/disconnect fees 4,252 + Other revenue 99 + Interest income 57,853 = 413,342; Sewer: Charges for services 243,334 + Interest income 22,497 = 265,831. 413,342 + 265,831 = 679,173 = statement total.
